source.scope: Mantine Resources, Events/log stream, Traces and Layers; TanStack Table and measured Events virtualization; incremental uPlot summaries; 2,000-span virtual waterfall; P07 browser evidence. Files/Preview, Radix/Tailwind/dependency cleanup, release gate, and P08B Preview isolation remain later work.

automatedEvidence.result: pass: TypeScript project build and Vite production bundle; existing bundle-size advisory only
pass: 27 dedicated P07 browser checks verified without snapshot update
pass: 0 (0) for every one of 22 screenshot pairs

coverage.P07_AC01: ResourcesView, EventsView, TracesView, and LayerStackView use Mantine surfaces and controls while preserving their existing routes and deep links.
coverage.P07_AC02: The fixture freezes time, supplies 2,000 events, verifies Tail-off query quiescence after the paused state settles, resumes into a last-good stale error, and preserves selection/expanded attributes.
coverage.P07_AC03: TanStack Table supplies the Events sort/row model; the fixture verifies timestamp/name sorting, keyboard selection, expanded attributes, and fewer than 128 mounted Event rows at 2,000 inputs.
coverage.P07_AC04: The trace fixture uses backend offset/event nodes, discovery remains sourced from the last 200 events, the layer detail explicitly says first 500, and 2,000 spans retain bounded virtual rows, detail, and a native overflow owner. Event trace links are explicit identifiers only.
coverage.P07_AC05: Resources maintains four uPlot canvases across a resize, exposes labelled numerical summaries, updates plot data without recreation, and uses ResizeObserver rather than a window resize listener.
coverage.P07_AC06: Dedicated 27-check browser suite, unit/build runs, full 161-check browser suite, Axe, screenshot triads, and visual review are recorded in this pack.

review.design: Approved by Codex for P07 Observability scope after visual inspection; external human reviewer remains unassigned.
review.engineering: Approved by Codex after the recorded Mantine migration, polling, table/chart/trace virtualization, test, build, browser, and zero-diff evidence.
review.accessibility: Approved by Codex for P07 scope: keyboard-selectable Events rows, labelled summaries, narrow Trace Drawer, explicit limits, and no Axe violations in all four P07 views.
review.decision: P07 Observability evidence is approved. It is not final production-screen visual approval and does not advance Preview isolation.
